title: GIG-3190: Add AGENTS.md Rule To Sync Postmaclone Config When Migrations Add PII
description: Adds a managed AGENTS.md rule requiring postmaclone.tables updates in ngramx.yml whenever migrations introduce PII columns, with regression tests and regenerated agent targets.

test_plan.description: Managed AGENTS.md template includes the postmaclone PII rule
steps: Confirm assertions for postmaclone.tables and post-clone anonymization pass
Open templates/agents/04-database-migrations.md and confirm the one-liner rule is present
Run php bin/ngramx sync-agents and confirm AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .cursor/rules/ngramx.mdc include the new rule
